about_short_description.short_description: Ta3meed offers PO financing solutions to small and medium resellers through a crowdfunding platform.

product.name: Purchase Order Financing Platform
product.description: A platform providing Sharia-compliant financing to SMEs based on government and large company purchase orders through debt-based crowdfunding.

product.name: Invoice and Payment Financing
product.description: An electronic service that finances invoices and payment claims for SMEs, providing up to 80% of invoice value with funding available within 48 hours.

identifier.value: Final Guarantee and Purchase Order Financing

product.name: Final Guarantee and Purchase Order Financing
product.description: A crowdfunding-based financing solution for SMEs holding government contracts, combining final guarantee and purchase order financing in one package.

product.name: Tameed AJEL Partner Financing Program
product.description: An off-balance sheet financing solution integrated into partner platforms, enabling immediate payout to merchants and flexible payment terms for buyers.

product.name: Nupco Vendor Financing Program
product.description: A financing program tailored for Nupco suppliers, providing quick invoice financing with a fully digital application and instant approval for SMEs.
